sources.entry: Vikunja - The to-do app to organize your life. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0/GPL-3.0 Go
Vikunja | To-do app to organise your life with lists, kanban and Gantt views

summary.one_liner: Vikunja is a self-hostable to-do and task manager written in Go, positioned as "the task manager you actually own."
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly points elsewhere: features, installation, build, development setup, and testing docs are all hosted on the Vikunja website rather than in the repository. It says the project offers a hosted version and a paid "Vikunja Pro" tier that adds an admin panel, audit logs, and time tracking. The README notes that the project uses LLM-assisted coding tools in parts of the codebase. Licensing is split: most of the repository is AGPL-3.0-or-later, and the desktop/ directory is GPL-3.0-or-later. Background images from Unsplash are included under the Unsplash License, which requires attribution. The metadata from awesome lists describes it as a to-do app with lists, kanban and Gantt views.
how_to_run: See the installation docs on the Vikunja home page
Build from source (documented on the Vikunja website)
Development setup and Magefile instructions are on the Vikunja website
notable: Self-hosted, open-source alternative to hosted to-do apps
Lists, kanban and Gantt views (per awesome-list metadata)
Optional hosted version and paid Vikunja Pro tier
Desktop app code under GPL-3.0-or-later in desktop/ directory
caveats: README is brief; installation and feature details live on the external website
Advanced features such as admin panel, audit logs and time tracking are in the paid Vikunja Pro tier
Parts of the codebase are developed with LLM-assisted coding tools
keywords: share task lists with my team
